text: Flags the LogFormatter ABC as pure ceremony — it declares an abstract format() method but adds nothing over logging.Formatter, and the subclasses already inherit from logging.Formatter directly
Flags LogHandlerFactory as a cargo-culted pattern — a class of static methods with no shared state is just a namespace; plain functions would be simpler
Flags the duplicated if/else formatter_type branching across create_console_handler and create_file_handler — the same two-branch conditional is copy-pasted rather than extracted
Flags the rigid three-handler setup (console + file + error file) as prompt-shaped — it reads like a response to 'set up logging with console, file, and error file' rather than a configurable system
Findings are grouped under markdown headers that include category name and severity, e.g., '## Missing Skepticism (error)' or '## Shallow Naming (warn)'
Output ends with a summary line matching the pattern 'vibe-check: N errors, N warnings across N files'
Each finding includes a file:line reference like 'handler.ts:35' or 'src/config.py:12'
